gloss: natural face; bare face without makeup

definitions.gloss: natural face; bare face without makeup
definitions.explanation: one's face without any makeup, cosmetic enhancements, or filters applied

examples.english: She has a naturally beautiful face.

examples.english: Her face with makeup and her natural face are quite different.

notes:
Combines {地|じ} (ground, base, natural state) and ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ (face). The prefix {地|じ} here means 'original' or 'unaltered,' the same {地|じ} found in ⟦{地毛|じげ}→地毛：16021_jige⟧ (natural hair) and ⟦{地声|じごえ}→地声：19937_jigoe⟧ (natural voice). Commonly discussed in the context of beauty, cosmetics, and social media.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地顔|じがお}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: to have a good natural face
- {地顔|じがお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧: to show one's natural face
- {地顔|じがお}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{化粧|けしょう}→化粧：02699_keshou⟧{顔|がお}: natural face vs. made-up face

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦すっぴん→すっぴん：09310_suppin⟧: bare face, no-makeup face — the more common casual term
- ⟦{素顔|すがお}→素顔：13802_sugao⟧: bare face, true face — can also mean 'true self' figuratively
- ⟦{地毛|じげ}→地毛：16021_jige⟧: natural hair — one's hair without dyeing or styling
